 The unit Details:
- BUA 3,272 sq. ft.
- Washroom 356 sq. ft.
- Kitchen area 1,378sq. ft.
- Terrace 3,143 sq. ft. (50% of the agreed BUA rent to be charged as rental fee)

Please reach out to CRC Property to obtain comprehensive information and arrange a viewing.

Company Profile: CRC (Commercial Real Estate Consultants) is a distinguished real estate brokerage, specializing in commercial properties across Dubai & Abu Dhabi. Founded by visionary thought leaders in the real estate industry, CRC serves both local and international clients who aspire to enhance their investments through the sale, lease, or purchase of commercial properties. Our team comprises skilled property experts who possess a profound understanding of the commercial real estate landscape. Each of our property consultants is carefully selected and meticulously trained to uphold the highest standards, representing our brand and advocating for your interests with utmost professionalism. Our achievements, however, extend beyond mere success. We are an interconnected network of industry professionals driven by a shared passion for real estate. Our role is that of facilitators, connecting individuals with spaces. Furthermore, within the communities where we live and operate, we have earned a reputation as trusted insiders, advisors, and confidants. At CRC, we proudly hold the mantle of market leaders in commercial real estate.
